rules._daily_note: Bitfunded: realized loss of the day + floating loss of open positions vs a fixed daily% x initial. Auto-fails on FLOATING.
rules._reset_note: 00:00 UTC+8 = 16:00 UTC = 12:00 noon in New York (EDT). Reset lands MIDDAY local, not overnight. May take until 00:10 UTC+8 to apply.
rules._dd_note: Confirmed static: measured against account quota, not a high-water mark. Profit permanently widens the buffer.
rules._min_days_note: CONFLICT: challenge page shows 0 (confirmed again on the $100k Expert tier), FAQ says at least 5. Confirm with support.
rules._fee_note: 0.04% of notional at entry AND exit = 0.08% round trip.
rules._margin_note: Cross 5x: the whole account backs every position. Exchange liquidation is unreachable at any size Bitfunded permits; the firm's 4%/6% floors are the effective liquidation model. Isolated would cut a runaway position at ~20% for its own margin; cross does not.
rules._basis_note: Bitfunded FAQ: daily limit is a FIXED amount from the INITIAL balance, resetting daily. Today's net P&L offsets it. Earlier versions of this config said day_start_balance - that was an unverified assumption.
